bio: Bilbao is not an easy place in which to make a name for yourself when it comes to food, however it is here that chef Álvaro Garrido decided to set up shop in a discreet building along the estuary, opposite the Ribera market. The pleasantly surprising interior decor of this restaurant, which owes its name to a former mine entrance that once existed beneath the building, features an open kitchen and a fusion of stone and wood (the bar is a single piece of oak) that combine with cutting-edge designer detail. Ably supported by his wife Lara Martín, the chef conjures up innovative cuisine with a hint of fusion influence on a single tasting menu (choose between a shorter and longer version).
